WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.cdscode, f."County Name" AS county,

         (s.avgscrread + s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrwrite) AS sat
  FROM frpm f
  LEFT JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = f.cdscode
  WHERE f."County Name" = 'Alameda'
    AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500
    AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
)
SELECT county,
       COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
       ROUND(AVG(fp), 2) AS avg_free_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(rp), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ch = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ch = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS noncharter_count,
       ROUND(AVG(sat), 2) AS avg_sat,
       COUNT(sat) AS sat_school_count
FROM base
GROUP BY county

),
best AS (

SELECT t.county, t.n AS exclusively_virtual_schools,

  (SELECT max(mx) FROM best b WHERE b.county = t.county) AS top_avg_reading
FROM top5 t

WITH v AS (

  FROM schools s LEFT JOIN satscores t ON t.cds = s.cdscode

c AS (SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS n FROM v GROUP BY county),
fifth AS (SELECT n FROM c ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 4),
top AS (SELECT c.county, c.n FROM c, fifth WHERE c.n >= fifth.n),
best AS (SELECT county, MAX(avgscrread) AS mx FROM v WHERE avgscrread IS NOT NULL GROUP BY county)

  b.mx
FROM top LEFT JOIN best b ON b.county = top.county
ORDER BY top.n DESC, top.county

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.cdscode, f."School Name", f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enr, f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm,
         f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS share
  FROM frpm f
  WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100 AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
),
picked AS (
  SELECT 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part, * FROM base WHERE frpm = (SELECT max(frpm) FROM base)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'smallest FRPM share', * FROM base WHERE share = (SELECT min(share) FROM base)
)
SELECT p.part, p."School Name", s.county, s.city, s.mailstreet, s.mailcity, s.mailstate, s.mailzip,
       s.website, p.enr AS enrollment_k12, p.frpm AS frpm_count, p.share AS frpm_share,
       (sa.avgscrread + sa.avgscrmath + sa.avgscrwrite) AS avg_total_sat,
       100.0 * sa.numge1500 / sa.numtsttakr AS pct_sat_1500_plus,
       s.opendate,
       CASE WHEN s.closeddate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS status
FROM picked p
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = p.cdscode
LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = p.cdscode
ORDER BY CASE p.part WHEN 'largest FRPM-eligible count' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

WITH w AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount)::numeric AS total_wd
  FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  GROUP BY a.district_id

WITH fl AS (
  SELECT l."loan_id", l."amount", l."account_id", l."duration", l."payments", l."status", c."client_id", c."birth_date"
  FROM loan l JOIN disp d ON d."account_id"=l."account_id" AND d."type"='OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON c."client_id"=d."client_id" WHERE c."gender"='F'
), top3 AS (
  SELECT * FROM fl WHERE "amount" >= (SELECT MIN("amount") FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "amount" FROM fl ORDER BY "amount" DESC LIMIT 3) t)
), reg_loans AS (
  SELECT dis."a3" AS region, COUNT(l."loan_id") AS region_loans
  FROM loan l JOIN account a ON a."account_id"=l."account_id"
  JOIN district dis ON dis."district_id"=a."district_id" GROUP BY 1
), dist_avg AS (
  SELECT "district_id", "a3" AS region, AVG("a11") AS dsal FROM district GROUP BY 1,2
), reg_sal AS (
  SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(dsal)::numeric, 2) AS region_avg_salary FROM dist_avg GROUP BY 1
), tx AS (
  SELECT "account_id", COUNT(*) AS tx_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN "type"='PRIJEM' THEN "amount" ELSE 0 END) AS deposits
  FROM trans GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT t."client_id", t."amount" AS loan_amount, t."duration" AS duration_months,
  ROUND((t."payments"*t."duration")::numeric, 2) AS total_payments,
  ROUND((t."payments"*t."duration" - t."amount")::numeric, 2) AS interest_paid,
  t."status" AS loan_status, dis."district_id", dis."a2" AS district_name, dis."a3" AS region,
  tx.tx_count, ROUND(COALESCE(tx.deposits,0)::numeric,2) AS total_deposits,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(tx.deposits,0) > 2*t."amount" THEN 'High Income'
       WHEN COALESCE(tx.deposits,0) > t."amount" THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS income_category,
  rl.region_loans, rs.region_avg_salary,
  DATE_PART('year', AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', t."birth_date"))::int AS age_2026_10_09
FROM top3 t
JOIN account a ON a."account_id"=t."account_id"
JOIN district dis ON dis."district_id"=a."district_id"
LEFT JOIN tx ON tx."account_id"=t."account_id"
LEFT JOIN reg_loans rl ON rl.region=dis."a3"
LEFT JOIN reg_sal rs ON rs.region=dis."a3"
ORDER BY t."amount" DESC

WITH gold AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id FROM card c JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold' AND d.account_id IS NOT NULL
),
tot AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn
  FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold)
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
ext AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (t.bank, t.account)) AS ext_cnt
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold) AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.account IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
ln AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_cnt FROM loan l
  WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold) GROUP BY l.account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT g.account_id, di.a2 AS district_name, di.a3 AS region,
    COALESCE(tot.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
    COALESCE(tot.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(ln.loan_cnt, 0) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(ext.ext_cnt, 0) AS external_counterparties
  FROM gold g
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = g.account_id
  JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
  LEFT JOIN tot ON tot.account_id = g.account_id
  LEFT JOIN ext ON ext.account_id = g.account_id
  LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.account_id = g.account_id
)
SELECT account_id, district_name, region, total_received, total_withdrawn, loan_count, external_counterparties,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC) AS rank
FROM base
ORDER BY rank, account_id

    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn
  FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold)
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
ext AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (t.bank, t.account)) AS ext_cnt
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold) AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.account IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
ln AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_cnt FROM loan l
  WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold) GROUP BY l.account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT g.account_id, di.a2 AS district_name, di.a3 AS region,
    COALESCE(tot.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
    COALESCE(tot.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(ln.loan_cnt, 0) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(ext.ext_cnt, 0) AS external_counterparties
  FROM gold g
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = g.account_id
  JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
  LEFT JOIN tot ON tot.account_id = g.account_id
  LEFT JOIN ext ON ext.account_id = g.account_id
  LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.account_id = g.account_id
)
SELECT account_id, district_name, region, total_received, total_withdrawn, loan_count, external_counterparties,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC) AS rank
FROM base
ORDER BY rank, account_id

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  WHERE a.district_id = 21 AND a.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
),
owner AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (dp.account_id) dp.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
  FROM disp dp JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER'
  ORDER BY dp.account_id, dp.disp_id
),
cards AS (
  SELECT dp.account_id, count(*) AS n_cards
  FROM card cd JOIN disp dp ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id
  WHERE cd.issued <= DATE '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY dp.account_id
),
loans AS (
  SELECT account_id, count(*) AS n_loans,
    bool_or(status = 'B') AS has_b,
    bool_or(status IN ('C','D')) AS has_cd
  FROM loan
  WHERE date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
tx AS (
  SELECT account_id, count(*) AS n_tx,
    COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount END), 0) AS money_in,
    COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ','VYBER') THEN amount END), 0) AS money_out,
    max(balance) AS peak_bal
  FROM trans
  WHERE date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND date <= DATE '1997-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
prof AS (
  SELECT b.account_id, b.opened, o.gender,
    date_part('year', age(DATE '1996-12-31', o.birth_date))::int AS age_1996,
    COALESCE(cd.n_cards, 0) AS n_cards,
    COALESCE(l.n_loans, 0) AS n_loans,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(l.n_loans, 0) = 0 THEN 'no loan'
      WHEN l.has_b THEN 'defaulted'
      WHEN l.has_cd THEN 'repaying'
      ELSE 'paid off'
    END AS loan_label,
    COALESCE(t.n_tx, 0) AS n_tx,
    COALESCE(t.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
    COALESCE(t.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
    COALESCE(t.peak_bal, 0) AS peak_bal
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.account_id = b.account_id
  LEFT JOIN cards cd ON cd.account_id = b.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loans l ON l.account_id = b.account_id
  LEFT JOIN tx t ON t.account_id = b.account_id
)
SELECT account_id, opened, gender, age_1996, n_cards, n_loans, loan_label, n_tx, money_in, money_out, peak_bal,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_bal DESC) AS peak_rank
FROM prof
ORDER BY peak_rank, account_id
final.answer: Built one profile row per Tabor (district 21) account opened on or before 31 Dec 1996, ordered by peak-balance rank (RANK, highest first) then account id. Owner gender and age come from the OWNER disposition; cards and loans are counted only if issued/approved on or before 31 Dec 1996; 1997 transaction count, money in (PRIJEM), money out (VYDAJ + VYBER) and peak balance use 1997 activity, with zeros where there is none. Loan label follows the B > C/D > A hierarchy with 'no loan' when none. The query returns 20 of the qualifying rows in the preview; the full result set is what the submitted SQL produces. Note: I excluded account 12 and similar accounts opened after 1996 since they were not held as of 31 Dec 1996.

)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d."driverid") AS young_second_fastest_drivers
FROM ranked x JOIN drivers d ON d."driverid" = x."driverid"
WHERE x.rk = 2 AND d."dob" >= DATE '1976-01-01'
final.answer: 26 drivers born on or after 1 January 1976 have set the second-fastest lap of a race. I ranked each driver's fastest lap time within each race (results.fastestlaptime) and counted distinct drivers who ranked 2nd, filtered to dob >= 1976-01-01. The results.rank column was not used because it is null or 0 for many rows.

queries.sql:
SELECT r."raceid", r."driverid", r."rank", r."fastestlaptime", r."fastestlapspeed", r."positionorder"
FROM results r WHERE r."raceid" = (SELECT MIN("raceid") FROM results) OR r."raceid" = 1000 ORDER BY r."raceid", r."rank" LIMIT 60

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "fastestlaptime" IS NULL) AS nulls, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "fastestlaptime" !~ '^\d{1,2}:\d{2}\.\d{3}$' AND "fastestlaptime" IS NOT NULL) AS badfmt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "rank" IS NULL) AS rank_nulls, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "rank"=0) AS rank0 FROM results

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT r."raceid", r."driverid", r."fastestlaptime",
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r."raceid" ORDER BY r."fastestlaptime") AS dr,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r."raceid" ORDER BY r."fastestlaptime") AS rk
  FROM results r WHERE r."fastestlaptime" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT d."driverid") FILTER (WHERE rk=2) AS by_rank,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d."driverid") FILTER (WHERE dr=2) AS by_dense,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d."driverid") FILTER (WHERE rk=2 AND d."dob" >= DATE '1976-01-01') AS young_rank,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d."driverid") FILTER (WHERE dr=2 AND d."dob" >= DATE '1976-01-01') AS young_dense
FROM ranked x JOIN drivers d ON d."driverid" = x."driverid"
WHERE x."raceid" IS NOT NULL

final.sql:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT q.driverid, q.raceid, q.q3,
         (split_part(q.q3, ':', 1)::int * 60000 + round(split_part(q.q3, ':', 2)::numeric * 1000))::bigint AS ms
  FROM qualifying q
  WHERE q.q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-5][0-9]\.[0-9]{3}$'
)
SELECT q.q3, q.ms, q.raceid, q.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality
FROM q JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = q.driverid
WHERE q.ms = (SELECT MIN(ms) FROM q)
ORDER BY q.raceid;

WITH best AS (
  SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS best_ms
  FROM laptimes
  WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY raceid, driverid
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT raceid, driverid, best_ms,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY best_ms) AS rk
  FROM best
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverid) AS drivers_count
FROM ranked r
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = r.driverid
WHERE r.rk = 2 AND d.dob >= DATE '1976-01-01';

WITH best AS (
  SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS best_ms
  FROM laptimes
  WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY raceid, driverid
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT raceid, driverid, best_ms,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY best_ms) AS rk,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY raceid, best_ms) AS tie_cnt
  FROM best
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverid) AS drivers_count,
       COUNT(*) AS rows_second,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.tie_cnt > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tied_rows
FROM ranked r
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = r.driverid
WHERE r.rk = 2 AND d.dob >= DATE '1976-01-01';

  SELECT cs.constructorid, r.year, MAX(cs.raceid) AS rid

  GROUP BY cs.constructorid, r.year
),

  SELECT l.constructorid, l.year, cs.points
  FROM last l JOIN constructorstandings cs ON cs.raceid=l.rid AND cs.constructorid=l.constructorid
),
tot AS (
  SELECT i.constructorid, i.name, i.url, COALESCE(SUM(s.points),0) AS career_points
  FROM ital i LEFT JOIN season s ON s.constructorid=i.constructorid
  GROUP BY i.constructorid, i.name, i.url
),
ranked AS (

The top three Italian constructors by career points (sum of each season's final constructor standings points) are:
1. Ferrari – 6,991.5 points – http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scuderia_Ferrari
2. Benetton – 861.5 points – http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Benetton_Formula
3. Toro Rosso – 381.0 points – http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scuderia_Toro_Rosso

There are no ties within the top three. Summing each constructor's per-race results instead gives the same top three order (Ferrari's total is slightly higher, at 7,081.5, under that method).

queries.sql:
SELECT c.constructorid, c.name, c.url, r.year, MAX(r.round) AS lastround, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM constructorstandings cs
JOIN races r ON r.raceid = cs.raceid
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid
WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian'
GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name, c.url, r.year
ORDER BY r.year LIMIT 20;
SELECT constructorid, name, nationality, url FROM constructors WHERE nationality = 'Italian';

WITH ital AS (SELECT constructorid, name, url FROM constructors WHERE nationality='Italian'),
last AS (
  SELECT cs.constructorid, r.year, MAX(cs.raceid) AS rid
  FROM constructorstandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceid=cs.raceid
  GROUP BY cs.constructorid, r.year
),
season AS (
  SELECT l.constructorid, l.year, cs.points
  FROM last l JOIN constructorstandings cs ON cs.raceid=l.rid AND cs.constructorid=l.constructorid
),
tot AS (
  SELECT i.constructorid, i.name, i.url, COALESCE(SUM(s.points),0) AS career_points
  FROM ital i LEFT JOIN season s ON s.constructorid=i.constructorid
  GROUP BY i.constructorid, i.name, i.url
)
SELECT name, url, career_points, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS rnk
FROM tot ORDER BY career_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT i.name, i.url, COALESCE(SUM(cr.points),0) AS total_pts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(cr.points),0) DESC) rnk
FROM constructors i LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON cr.constructorid=i.constructorid
WHERE i.nationality='Italian'
GROUP BY i.constructorid, i.name, i.url ORDER BY total_pts DESC LIMIT 20;

WITH carbon_mols AS (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element='c'),
ac AS (SELECT molecule_id, count(*) AS n_atoms, count(*) FILTER (WHERE element='c') AS n_c, count(*) FILTER (WHERE element='cl') AS n_cl FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id),
bc AS (SELECT molecule_id, count(*) AS n_bonds, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bond_type IN ('=','#')) AS n_mult FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id),
ct AS (SELECT b.molecule_id, count(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS n_ctb FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id=b.bond_id JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id=c.atom_id WHERE a.element='c' GROUP BY b.molecule_id)
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, COALESCE(ac.n_atoms,0) AS n_atoms, COALESCE(bc.n_bonds,0) AS n_bonds, COALESCE(ac.n_c,0) AS n_carbon, COALESCE(ac.n_cl,0) AS n_chlorine, COALESCE(ct.n_ctb,0) AS n_carbon_bonds, COALESCE(bc.n_mult,0) AS n_multiple_bonds,
DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ct.n_ctb,0) DESC, COALESCE(ac.n_atoms,0) DESC, m.molecule_id ASC) AS rnk
FROM molecule m JOIN carbon_mols cm ON cm.molecule_id=m.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN ac ON ac.molecule_id=m.molecule_id LEFT JOIN bc ON bc.molecule_id=m.molecule_id LEFT JOIN ct ON ct.molecule_id=m.molecule_id
ORDER BY rnk

final.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name, t.treatment_type_code FROM professionals p JOIN treatments t ON t.professional_id = p.professional_id ORDER BY p.first_name, t.treatment_type_code
final.answer: The database has no treatment description column; treatments only stores a treatment_type_code, so the closest available answer is each professional's first name with the treatment type codes they have performed (EXAM, VAC, WALK). Results: Danny – VAC; Domenica – VAC, WALK; Karley – VAC; Monte – EXAM, WALK; Ruben – EXAM, WALK; Sigurd – EXAM, VAC; Velva – WALK; Vernice – EXAM. Note that the codes are not expanded into descriptions because no lookup table for treatment types exists.

queries.sql: SELECT p.first_name, t.treatment_type_code, COUNT(*) AS n FROM professionals p JOIN treatments t ON t.professional_id = p.professional_id GROUP BY p.first_name, t.treatment_type_code ORDER BY p.first_name LIMIT 20
